text:
evan: quick heads-up from mobile QA: on 360px widths the console table wraps and the right-side action chip falls beneath the title, making the tap target tiny. screenshot: https://img.redwood/360-wrap.png
priya: saw that. when the chip wraps it also hides the row divider so rows look merged.
noah: quick idea: at <=380px switch the list to a dense two-line card: title on line 1, meta+actions on line 2 with actions right-aligned. keeps chips visible and larger.
kai: accessibility: ensure action icons are 44px and order actions first in DOM so keyboard users reach primary quickly. also provide an aria-label like "Open item actions" for the overflow.
evan: copy tweak: shorten "Open actions" -> "Actions" for small screens so it doesn't wrap.
noah: CSS prototype works: ```@media(max-width:380px){ .row{display:flex;flex-direction:column} .actions{align-self:flex-end;min-width:44px} }```
priya: also check safe-area on phones with notches so actions don't sit under the home indicator.
design-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood/preview/360-dense-cards — please QA touch targets + keyboard nav.
evan: plan: noah will open PR with prototype, kai will do a11y pass, priya will run quick thumb reach tests tomorrow. aiming for next patch.
